parameters: The roads of Cavite are clogged with refugees,
farmers with children on their shoulders,
The Spanish are not just coming. They are already here.
Silang. Col. Jose Tagle organizes a rear guard
The Spanish vanguard is an hour away.
But we can delay them. Give the people in Imus time.
A brief, brutal fight at the crossroads buys
the retreat the time it needs.
Silang falls. Then Dasmariñas. Then Imus. Then Bacoor.
